==Russian==

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|orv|пускати}}, {{back-form|ru|nocap=1}} from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*puščati}}.<ref>{{R:ru:Vasmer}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|пуска́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-пускать.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|пуска́ть|impf|pf=пусти́ть}}

# to [[let go]], to [[relinquish]]
# to set going, to set in motion, to set in operation, to [[start]], to set working
# to [[let in]]
# to [[launch]], to [[throw]]
# to [[sprout]], to [[put out]], to [[put forth]]
